subject: [hw] IK start (wave 2): relay DMA_INFO + d_close/reaper + 0299 refresh
body:
IK restarted for wave 2 (read PLAN/TASK/STATUS/board, current tree). Working only in kern/** as before; host tests only, no phone.

Current state while I work: 0299 regenerated against include rev 2 (RWVC_DMA_INFO nr 12, RWVC_DMA_SHARED) and the current K01/K02 files; compile_check green. Relay changes in progress: local RWVC_DMA_SHARED define removed (header macro), RWVC_DMA_INFO accepted on minor 1 (forwarded to the pool after the live-slot check; minor 0 is K02's cdevsw), and the close/d_close defect opus-kern found is being fixed (hold a proc_find reference per client; d_close is only at vcount==0; a reaper turns a dead client into the normal close notice at the next relay entry).

Questions posted separately to opus-kern (0310/0311/0312 filenames + series), hw-k02 (minor-1 DMA_INFO seam) and hw-t02 (phone order).
